notes.title: Patch Version 0.3.3: Changelog
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292583/76048da049375786bd8afbfc8006b4344adebb21.png[/img]
[h3][b]Fixes and changes:[/b][/h3] 
[*] Various navigation system fixes across the levels
[*] Cutscenes system introduced
[*] More orders added
[*] Fainted mortals now create a sleep fetter
[*] Powers that require a specific fear to apply reaction now display it in the description
[*] Load Game is available to switch profile after “New Game”
[*] Intro sound is now pausable
[*] HUD is now hidden on cutscenes and ghost briefs
[*] Achievements fixes
[*] Various gameplay fixes
[*] Conversations tweaked to choose positions of participants more precisely
[*] Sounds volume for voices and radio increased
[*] Party behaviors on Weird Seance
[*] Fixes for the cutscene on Summoners Not Included
[*] Mortals now will not call for Handyman if Arclight is already released
[*] Fears cloud and icons fixes
[*] StayKold animations fixes
[*] Possess power fixes
[*] Various fixes for “witness” based powers

In case of problem with GPU crash or too high overload - please try to use -d3d11 parameter added to startup parameters.

[h3]We’re very grateful for your support and passion — every message, suggestion, and report helps shape the game. Thank you for being on this journey with us. More updates coming soon![/h3]

notes.title: Patch Version 0.3: Changelog
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292583/2d478d55e0385eaa80fc7a1a96a73ff22dc65bce.png[/img]  
[h3][b]Gameplay Updates:[/b] [/h3] 
[list]  
[*] Changed save data structure due to fixes, this will require clearing save game data in folder:  
  [code]C:\Users\YOUR_USER\AppData\Local\GhostMasterRemake\Saved\SaveGames[/code]  
  (Especially if you experience issues with buying ghost powers or powers not being assigned after purchase.)  
[*] Achievements implemented
[*] We included a crash reporter. In case of a crash, please post it in the Problems & Bugs section.  
  Crash reports are created as a file in folder:[code]C:\Users\YOUR_USER\AppData\Local\GhostMasterRemake\Saved\Crashes\[/code][*] Fixed a bug where rebinding camera rotation from "Q" and "E" still caused camera rotation  
[*] Various sounds are now bound to the proper sound class, fixing volume setting issues  
[*] Witches' Shield fixes
[*] "Uneasy" status on mortals now shown with x2 effects  
[*] Prisoned ghosts no longer have learned powers when replaying a mission  
[*] New VFX for ghost spawn & despawn  
[*] Dreams POV added  
[*] Various fixes for gamepad navigation  
[*] Interactive lighting reactability tweaks  
[*] Mortals' movement behavior against the wind added  
[*] Ghosts and powers localization fixes  
[*] Contrast and Exposure graphical settings added  
[*] Invert Mouse Y setting added  
[*] Rotation now respects speed setting  
[*] Application pauses when minimized or Alt-Tab is used  
[*] Camera rotation via mouse now locks the cursor  
[*] Gamepad navigation improved  
[*] Fixed several crashes due to internal logic of object destruction (mortal flee, ability ends, etc.)  
[*] StayKold's health is increased on both difficulty levels  
[*] Ghost intro and repeat ghost intro can now only be skipped with the special button ([b]Space Bar[/b])  
[*] Shadows optimization  
[*] Separate lighting setup for non-lumen settings  
[*] UI screen flow modified  
[*] Movie player switched to Bink Player  
[/list][h3][b]Mortals:[/b][/h3][list]  
[*] Higher priority for Flee  
[*] Scepticism influence fixes for various powers  
[*] AI navigation paths should stack less now  
[*] Investigate mode for mortals should be more reliable  
[*] Mortals now have a separate behavior set in darkness (slow movement, interacting with switches, etc.)  
[*] Pickable items for mortals tweaked and bug-fixed  
[*] Anti-stuck system for mortals' movement added  
[*] Various navigation fixes  
[*] Mortals' toilet need decreased  
[*] More mortal status images added  
[*] Known fears refactored  
[/list][h3][b]Powers:[/b][/h3][list]  
[*] Power Ladder fixes for deactivating powers  
[*] Arboreal Prison - behavior and effect adjusted  
[*] Sleeping people are not affected by specific powers  
[*] Hypnotic Image now works again  
[*] Gifts overall behavior fixes and spawn location improvements  
[*] Phobia changing fears  
[*] Pursuit powers customized per ghost  
[*] Swarm powers customized per ghost  
[*] Unearthly Calm bug (effect not removing) should be fixed now  
[*] Hidden Maze tweaks and fixes  
[*] Voice on the Wind should now work  
[*] Spawn locations for power effects tweaked  
[/list][h3][b]Fetters:[/b][/h3][list]  
[*] Various fixes for ghost fetters  
[*] Fetters on the lower floor while outside are now clickable and bindable  
[/list][h3][b]Level Adjustments:[/b][/h3] 

[u]Calamity:[/u][list]  
[*] Various fixes for Police and Handyman scripts  
[/list][u]Spooky Hollow:[/u][list]  
[*] Various fixes for Dragoon behavior and puzzle  
[*] Replaced a tree  
[*] Level name and translation fixes  
[*] Blackcrow shed is destructible  
[*] Fixes for Scarecrow puzzle  
[/list][u]Unusual Suspects:[/u][list]  
[*] Prisoners now flee when freed  
[*] Blue Murder puzzle script fixes  
[/list][u]Epilogue:[/u][list]  
[*] Mortals can now fix wards  
[*] Boss fixes  
[/list]  
[h3]Glimpse of What's Coming Soon:[/h3][list]  
[*] More orders  
[*] Mods  
[*] New ghosts  
[*] More QoL changes and optimization  
[/list]  

[h3]Thank You for Your Support![/h3]


[i][b]With this new patch, we want to take a moment to express our gratitude to our incredible community. Your feedback, dedication, and time have been invaluable in shaping the game. Every bug report, suggestion, and discussion helps us improve and refine the experience.

We truly appreciate your patience and enthusiasm as we continue to develop and enhance the game. While we may not always be able to respond to every message, please know that we see and consider all of your input. Your support drives us forward, and we’re committed to delivering the best possible experience.

Thank you for being part of this journey with us—there’s more to come![/b][/i]

notes.title: Patch Version 0.1: Changelog
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292583/4d0a99ffe36c2dd2db73d6d74a80ef0dc56e3de4.jpg[/img][u]Gameplay Updates:[/u]
[list]
[*] Ghost powers can now be selected before spawning and are retained afterward.
[*] Added a hotkey for switching between floors: hold RMB and scroll the mouse wheel.
[*] Key rebinds can now be adjusted within the same room.
[*] Ghost powers will not activate if there isn’t enough Plasm.
[*] Continuous powers have been added.
[*] The time before losing a level has been increased.
[*] Hovering over a power button in the context menu displays its cost both below the button and in a popup.
[*] Context menus for ghosts and mortals can be opened by clicking on them in the world.
[*] The Luck state is now displayed as an effect above mortals’ heads.
[*] Power cast times and delays have been reduced.
[*] Powers now target mortals more accurately.
[*] The camera can now zoom closer to specific locations.
[*] Attraction powers display their effects above mortals’ heads.
[*] Mortals’ descriptions are now translated correctly.
[*] Various fetters on levels have been tweaked and new ones added.
[*] Turning lights off no longer makes the scene completely dark (if lights were initially present).
[*] The "Recommended" feature has been adjusted to align closer to the original game.
[*] Added an Astral Choir sound effect when zooming out too far.
[/list]
[u]User Interface (UI):[/u]
[list]
[*] The time in Free Roam mode has been increased, and button positions on the screen have been adjusted.
[*] Floor switch buttons are now functional.
[*] While a mortal is fleeing, their "X" icon blinks.
[*] Volume settings now load and apply correctly at game startup.
[/list]
[u]Fetters:[/u]
[list]
[*] Mortals who sleep now create a “Sleeping” fetter (though not perfectly aligned with their models yet).
[*] Added Child fetters for child characters.
[/list]
[u]Ghoul Room:[/u]
[list]
[*] Ceilings are now visible again.
[/list]
[u]Ghost Updates:[/u]
[list]
[*] Missing purchasable powers for ghosts, such as Weather Witch and Knuckles, have been restored.
[*] BlueMurder no longer has the Inside fetter.
[*] Added or adjusted ghost release methods for Daydreamer, Electrospasm, and Whisperwind (work in progress).
[*] Banzai now appears in the prisoned ghosts panel after being released.
[/list]
[u]Level Adjustments:[/u]
[list]
[*] Summoners Not Included:
[list]
[*] The Professor no longer leaves the basement.
[*] Camera movement is now restricted to a zone around the cabin.
[/list]
[*] Phantom of the Operating Room:
[list]
[*] Win conditions now require scaring only doctors and nurses, not all mortals.
[/list]
[*] Calamity:
[list]
[*] The Painting fetter has been restored.
[*] The TeaSet no longer has the Corpse fetter.
[*] Fixed the logic for releasing Hardboiled.
[/list]
[*] [b]Weird Science: [/b]Missing mortals have been restored.
[*] [b]Haunting 101: [/b]The spawn side has been rotated to the opposite direction, matching the original.
[*] Posters have been replaced.
[/list]
[u]Powers:[/u]
[list]
[*] Restored Kinesis and Telekinetic (TK) movement.
[*] Effects for Danse Macabre, Domination, Quake, and Tremor have been updated, including camera feedback.
[*] Fog, ThunderClap, and Distant Thunder effects have been improved.

[/list]
[u]Settings:[/u]
[list]
[*] Added options for controlling Motion Blur.
[*] Added an option for enabling or disabling V-Sync.
[*] Added an option to adjust Smooth Camera settings.
[/list]
